name: Character Inspector
description: See every character's code point and name, and find invisible characters, lookalikes and hidden direction controls
help: Paste text to list every character with its code point, name, category, script and UTF-8 / UTF-16 bytes. Characters that need attention are highlighted in the text.
Invisible characters (zero-width spaces, BOMs, word joiners, variation selectors) often break passwords, identifiers and comparisons.
Direction controls such as U+202E can make text display differently from how it is stored — the “Trojan Source” attack used in source code and file names.
Lookalikes are characters from other scripts that look like ASCII, such as the Cyrillic “а” in pаypal.com. Words that mix scripts are listed separately.
Clean removes invisible characters and direction controls, turns special spaces into normal spaces, and can replace lookalikes and normalize to NFC or NFKC. Emoji joiners are kept.
Lookup finds characters by code point (U+1F600, 0x4E2D, 😀, \u{1F600}) or by name, and shows how to write them in Rust, JavaScript, Python, Java, HTML, CSS and URLs.
